title: Fiere attropos (Moulu)
desc: Pierre Moulu, Fiere attropos. 5 voices (Tenor I, Tenor II, Bassus I, Bassus II, Bassus III), each on its own staff. No text in this edition. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
